newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin has pneumonia but temperature normal.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin has pneumonia but temperature normal.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin has pneumonia but his temperature is normal, the Kremlin said after doctors examined him at Moscow's Central Clinical Hospital on Thursday morning.
A five-line Kremlin statement said the 65-year-old president was being treated with antibiotics but gave no give other details.
"Treatment of the pneumonia is being carried out with modern antibiotics and with general therapy," the Kremlin said.
Yeltsin was admitted to hospital on Wednesday evening on doctors' orders after they said they detected the first symptoms of pneumonia.
He had returned to work in the Kremlin only on December 23 following heart surgery on November 5.
The surgeon who led the operation said Yeltsin's new illness was not related to the quintuple heart bypass and that his overall health allowed him to perform his duties as president.
